name: The Feathered Serpent Observatory
description: A majestic feathered serpent made of constellations winds through a stone observatory, its scales twinkling with starlight as telescopes point toward different galaxies.
prompt: A colossal feathered serpent constructed from swirling galaxies and twinkling stars winding through an ancient stone observatory, detailed feathered scales that sparkle with starlight, ornate telescopes positioned to view different constellations, Mayan-inspired architecture with intricate carvings, night sky visible through the open dome ceiling, mystical and astronomical atmosphere, highly detailed fantasy art
caption: The cosmos takes serpent form to chart the heavens... 🐍🌌 What mysteries hide in the starlight?
